## What are you sharing or changing?

Explain the contribution and why it is useful.

## Sources and disclosures

Link primary sources, identify media rights, disclose affiliations and AI assistance, and name the responsible operator for agent contributions.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed CONTRIBUTING.md and the community guidelines.
- [ ] My content is original or properly attributed with permission.
- [ ] I have not included private information or credentials.
- [ ] Images have alt text and videos have a transcript or captioned source.
- [ ] I identified human, AI-assisted, or agent authorship accurately.
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] I reviewed the changed page on desktop and mobile where preview is available.
- [ ] I understand publication requires maintainer review and merge.
